facts.statement: Altirhinus lived during the Early Cretaceous period, specifically from the Barremian to the Albian stages.
facts.quote: fossil_range: Early Cretaceous (Barremian to Albian),

facts.statement: Altirhinus was a hadrosauroid ornithopod dinosaur that lived in Mongolia during the Early Cretaceous period.
facts.quote: Altirhinus (; "high nose") is a genus of hadrosauroid ornithopod dinosaur from the Early Cretaceous period of Mongolia.

facts.statement: All known Altirhinus specimens were found in 1981 by Soviet and Mongolian scientists in the Khuren Dukh Formation of Dornogovi Province, Mongolia.
facts.quote: All known specimens of Altirhinus were recovered in 1981 during collaborative expeditions organized by Soviet and Mongolian scientists, from the Khuren Dukh Formation in the Dornogovi Province of Mongolia.

facts.statement: Fossils now identified as Altirhinus were originally classified as the species Iguanodon orientalis, which was described in 1952.
facts.quote: The remains of this animal were originally referred to the species Iguanodon orientalis, which was first described in 1952.

facts.statement: The genus Altirhinus was named by British paleontologist David B. Norman in 1998.
facts.quote: British paleontologist David B. Norman named them Altirhinus kurzanovi in 1998.

facts.statement: The species name kurzanovi honors Sergei Kurzanov, the Russian paleontologist who discovered the specimens in 1981.
facts.quote: There is one known species (A. kurzanovi), which honors Sergei Kurzanov, the influential Russian paleontologist who originally found the specimens in 1981.

facts.statement: The original description estimated Altirhinus reached a length of 8 meters from snout to tail tip.
facts.quote: According to the original description, the entire body probably extended 8 m from snout to tail tip.

facts.statement: A 2010 estimate by Gregory S. Paul placed Altirhinus at 6.5 meters long and weighing 1.1 tonnes.
facts.quote: In 2010 Gregory S. Paul estimated the length at 6.5 meters (21 ft), the weight at 1.1 tonnes.

facts.statement: Altirhinus was a herbivore that walked or ran on two legs but likely used four legs when feeding on the ground.
facts.quote: Altirhinus was herbivorous and bipedal when walking or running, but probably became quadrupedal when feeding from the ground.

facts.statement: Altirhinus possessed a sharp spike on its first digit that may have been used for defense or breaking seed and fruit shells.
facts.quote: The first digit was a simple sharp spike, as seen in Iguanodon. Aside from defense, the thumb spike could possibly have also been used for breaking the shells of seeds or fruit.

facts.statement: Altirhinus had a large gap between its beak and chewing teeth, allowing it to crop vegetation with its beak while simultaneously chewing.
facts.quote: There is a large diastema, or gap, between the keratinous beak on the front of the mouth and the main chewing teeth in the side of the mouth, which would allow the two sections to work independently, so Altirhinus could crop with its beak while simultaneously chewing with its teeth.

facts.statement: The nasal arch may have been used for vocalization, visual display, or sexual display, though evidence is limited to only two skulls.
facts.quote: Alternatively, it may have facilitated communication through vocalization or visual display. As only two skulls have been located, it is entirely possible that the arched snout is only found in one sex, in which case it may have been used for sexual display, like in modern-day elephant seals.

facts.statement: Altirhinus is classified as an advanced iguanodontian positioned just below the family Hadrosauridae, though its exact placement in the family tree is debated.
facts.quote: Altirhinus is definitely an advanced iguanodontian, just basal to the family Hadrosauridae, but there is little agreement on the arrangement of genera and species in this area of the ornithopod family tree.

facts.statement: In its original description, Altirhinus was placed in the family Iguanodontidae alongside Iguanodon and Ouranosaurus.
facts.quote: In the original description, it was included with Iguanodon and Ouranosaurus in a family Iguanodontidae (Norman, 1998).

facts.statement: Altirhinus kurzanovi was the only known species in the extinct genus, living in Asia during the Middle Cretaceous, approximately 110 million years ago in the Albian stage.
facts.quote: Altirhinus kurzanovi ("hocico alto de Sergei Kurzanov") es la única especie conocida del género extinto Altirhinus de dinosaurio ornitópodo iguanodóntido, que vivió a mediados del período Cretácico, hace aproximadamente 110 millones de años, en el Albiense, en lo que hoy es Asia.

facts.statement: Altirhinus was a herbivore that walked quadrupedally and ran bipedally, feeding on low vegetation.
facts.quote: A.kurzanovi fue un herbívoro que caminaba en posición cuadrúpeda y corría bípedo, alimentándose de la vegetación baja.

facts.statement: The total body length of Altirhinus was estimated to be approximately 8 meters from snout to tail tip.
facts.quote: El cuerpo entero probablemente se extendía con 8 metros desde el hocico hasta la punta de la cola.

facts.statement: In 2010, Gregory S. Paul estimated Altirhinus to be 6.5 meters long and weigh 1100 kilograms.
facts.quote: En 2010 Gregory S. Paul estimó el tamaño en 6,5 metros y un peso de 1100 kilogramos.

facts.statement: The skull of Altirhinus measured 760 mm in length and featured a distinctive high nasal arch, which gives the genus its name.
facts.quote: El cráneo solo medía 760 mm de largo, con una amplia boca y un distintivo arco alto en el tope de su hocico, del cual deriva su nombre.

facts.statement: Altirhinus had a wide mouth with 26 teeth in the upper jaw, 24 in the lower jaw, a third set of replacement teeth, and ended in a horny beak.
facts.quote: La boca se ensancha hacia rostral con 26 dientes en el maxilar 24 en el predentario y una tercera de dientes del reemplazo, terminando en un pico córneo.

facts.statement: Altirhinus had shorter front limbs than hind limbs, with central toes forming hooves to support its weight.
facts.quote: Los miembros delanteros eran más cortos que los traseros con los dedos centrales que formaban un casco para soporta el peso.

facts.statement: Researchers have proposed various functions for Altirhinus's nasal arch, including cooling blood, conserving water, or enhancing the sense of smell.
facts.quote: Muchas diversas funciones se han propuesto para el arco nasal. Pudo haber contenido tejidos para refrescar la sangre, para conservar el agua, o para aumentar el sentido del olor.

facts.statement: Alternatively, the nasal arch may have facilitated communication through vocalization or visual display.
facts.quote: Alternativamente, pudo haber facilitado la comunicación a través de la vocalización o de la representación visual.

facts.statement: Given that only two skulls are known, it is possible the arched snout was used for sexual display, similar to modern elephant seals.
facts.quote: Como se han localizado solamente dos cráneos, es enteramente posible que el hocico arqueado se vea solamente en un género, en este caso pudo haber sido utilizado para la exhibición sexual, como en los elefantes marinos de hoy en día.

facts.statement: All known Altirhinus specimens were collected in 1981 by a joint Mongolian-Soviet expedition in the Khukhtek Formation of Dornogovi Province, Mongolia.
facts.quote: Todos los especímenes conocidos de Altirhinus fueron recogidos en 1981 por un expedición conjunta mongola-soviética a la Formación Khukhtek en la provincia de Dornogovi de Mongolia.

facts.statement: Altirhinus lived during the Aptian and Albian stages of the Early Cretaceous, approximately 125 to 100 million years ago.
facts.quote: Esta formación se formó durante el Aptiense y el Albiense del Cretácico inferior, hace aproximadamente 125 a 100 millones de años.

facts.statement: The holotype of Altirhinus consists of a well-preserved left skull and some postcranial material including hand, foot, shoulder, and pelvic pieces.
facts.quote: El holotipo es un cráneo que posee el lado izquierdo bien preservado, y algún material postcraneal que consiste de piezas de la mano, pies, hombro y cintura pélvica.

facts.statement: A second, less well-preserved skull was recovered in association with ribs, vertebrae, and a complete hind leg.
facts.quote: Otro cráneo, pero preservado ha sido recuperado, en asociación con costillas, vértebras y una pata trasera completa.

facts.statement: A third specimen is known from complete limbs and an association of 34 tail vertebrae belonging to a small individual.
facts.quote: Un tercer espécimen se conoce por los miembros completos y una asociación de 34 vértebras de la cola, pertenecientes a un individuo pequeño.

facts.statement: There are also two fragmentary skeletons presumed to be juveniles that have not yet been studied in detail.
facts.quote: Hay también dos esqueletos fragmentarios presumiblemente de ejemplares juveniles, que todavía no se han estudiado en detalle.

facts.statement: Specimens of this species were originally referred to Iguanodon orientalis, which was described in 1952.
facts.quote: Los especímenes de esta especie fueron originalmente referidos a Iguanodon orientalis, que fuera descrito en 1952.

facts.statement: Because the 1981 specimens were clearly distinguishable from Iguanodon and lacked unique features of I. orientalis, a new name was required, given in 1998 by David B. Norman as Altirhinus kurzanovi.
facts.quote: Ninguna de las particularidades exclusivas de I. orientalis fueron compartidas con los especímenes de 1981, que eran claramente distinguibles de Iguanodon, por lo que un nuevo nombre fue requerido, este le fue dado en 1998 por David B. Norman cuando lo llamó Altirhinus kurzanovi.

facts.statement: The name Altirhinus was derived from the Latin word altus ("high") and the Greek word rhinos ("nose" or "snout").
facts.quote: El nuevo nombre fue creado a partir de la palabra latina, altus ("alto") y la palabra griega, rhinos ("nariz" u "hocico").

facts.statement: The only known species, A. kurzanovi, honors Sergei Kurzanov, the Russian paleontologist who originally found the specimens in 1981.
facts.quote: Hay solo una especie conocida, A. kurzanovi, la cual honra a Sergei Kurzanov, el paleontólogo ruso quien originalmente encontró los especímenes en 1981.

facts.statement: Altirhinus is definitely an iguanodontian, just basal to Hadrosauridae, though there is little agreement on the arrangement of genera and species in this area of the ornithopod family tree.
facts.quote: Altirhinus es definitivamente un iguanodóntido, apenas basal a Hadrosauridae, pero hay poco acuerdo en el arreglo de los géneros y especie en esta área del árbol de familia de los ornitópodos.

facts.statement: In its original description, Altirhinus was included with Iguanodon and Ouranosaurus in the family Iguanodontidae.
facts.quote: En la descripción original, fue incluido con Iguanodon y Ouranosaurus en una familia Iguanodontidae.

facts.statement: All recent analyses find Altirhinus more derived than Iguanodon and Ouranosaurus, but less derived than Protohadros, Probactrosaurus, and hadrosaurids.
facts.quote: Todos los análisis más recientes encuentran a Altirhinus más derivado que cualquiera de esos dos géneros, pero menos que Protohadros, Probactrosaurus, y los hadrosáuridos.

facts.statement: Two earlier studies placed Eolambia between Altirhinus and hadrosaurids, while Norman's analysis found the two genera share a clade.
facts.quote: Dos de los estudios anteriores también colocan Eolambia entre Altirhinus y los hadrosáuridos, mientras que el análisis de Norman encuentra que los dos géneros comparten a clado.

facts.statement: One study places Fukuisaurus as just basal to Altirhinus, according to the only analysis in which it was included.
facts.quote: Mientras que un estudio coloca a Fukuisaurus como apenas basal a Altirhinus según el único análisis en el cual se ha incluido.

facts.statement: Altirhinus's front limbs were about half the length of its hind limbs, suggesting it was primarily bipedal.
facts.quote: Sus miembros delanteros eran aproximadamente de la mitad de la longitud de sus miembros traseros, Altirhinus aparece haber sido sobre todo bípedo.

facts.statement: However, Altirhinus's wrist bones were thick and cubic, and its three central hand digits were broad, hyperextensible, and ended in hoof-like bones, indicating the front limbs could also support weight.
facts.quote: Sin embargo, sus carpianos (huesos de la muñeca) eran gruesos y cúbicos, y los tres dedos medios de su mano eran anchos, hiperextendibles, y terminado en huesos similares a cascos. Esto indica que los miembros delanteros eran también capaces de soportar el peso.

facts.statement: Like many ornithopods, Altirhinus may have spent significant time in a quadrupedal position, perhaps while feeding.
facts.quote: Como muchos ornitópodos, Altirhinus pudo haber pasado una cantidad significativa de tiempo en una posición cuadrúpeda, quizás mientras se alimentaba.

facts.statement: Besides defense, Altirhinus's thumb claw may have been used to break seed or fruit shells.
facts.quote: Aparte de defensa, la púa pulgar se habría podido también utilizar posiblemente para romper las cáscaras de semillas o fruta.

facts.statement: The fifth digit was somewhat opposable to the rest of the hand and may have been useful for grasping food.
facts.quote: El quinto dígito era algo oponible al resto de la mano y pudo haber sido útil para agarrar el alimento.

facts.statement: A large diastema between the horny beak and the tooth battery allowed the two sections to work independently, enabling Altirhinus to crop with its beak while simultaneously chewing with its teeth.
facts.quote: Hay una diastema o espacio grande entre el pico queratinoso en el frente de la boca y la batería de dientes el lado de la boca, que permitiría que las dos secciones trabajaran independientemente, así que Altirhinus podría cosechar con su pico mientras que simultáneamente masticaba con sus dientes.

facts.statement: Altirhinus was one of the most advanced iguanodontians with wide mouths flaring outward at the tip.
facts.quote: Altirhinus era uno de los iguanodóntidos más avanzados con hocicos amplios hacia fuera en el extremo.

facts.statement: This wide snout is possibly an example of convergent evolution with hadrosaurids, famous for their wide "duck-bill" snouts.
facts.quote: Este es posiblemente un ejemplo de evolución convergente con los hadrosáuridos, famosos por sus anchos hocicos "pico de pato".

facts.statement: The time range for Altirhinus is recorded as Albian to Albian, from 110.1 to 100.5 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Albian to Albian (110.1 to 100.5 million years ago)
